widget.name: Email Template Editor
widget.description: Load, edit and save email templates with the React Email 6 editor.

property.caption: Document
property.description: String attribute holding the editable template as JSON. This is the source of truth: it is what the editor loads and it round-trips without loss. Use an unlimited-length string attribute.

property.caption: Email HTML
property.description: String attribute that receives the rendered, send-ready email HTML on save. When no Document attribute is configured this attribute is also used to load the template. Use an unlimited-length string attribute.

property.caption: Plain text
property.description: Optional string attribute that receives the plain-text alternative of the email on save.

property.caption: Subject
property.description: Optional string attribute for the email subject. When set, a subject field is shown above the editor.

property.caption: Save mode
property.description: Manual: changes stay in the editor until Save is pressed. Automatic: changes are written to the attributes after a short pause.

property.caption: Change delay (ms)
property.description: Milliseconds of inactivity after an edit before the widget reacts: in automatic save mode it writes to the attributes, and in both modes it runs the On change action.

property.caption: Placeholder
property.description: Text shown in empty paragraphs. Leave empty to use the editor default.

property.caption: Warn on unsaved changes
property.description: Ask the browser to confirm before leaving the page while the template has unsaved changes. Only applies in manual save mode.

property.caption: Show toolbar
property.description: Show the toolbar with save, undo/redo, view switcher and panel controls.

property.caption: Show view switcher
property.description: Let the user switch between Design, Preview, HTML and Text views.

property.caption: Show style inspector
property.description: Show the panel that edits the styling of the selected block and of the template as a whole.

property.caption: Height
property.description: Fixed uses the height below. Fill stretches the editor to the height of its parent container, which must have a height of its own.

property.caption: Height (px)
property.description: Height of the widget in pixels.

property.caption: Theme
property.description: Base styling applied to the email. Custom lets you supply your own style overrides.

property.caption: Theme configuration
property.description: JSON such as: { "extends": "basic", "styles": { "body": { "backgroundColor": "#f6f9fc" }, "button": { "borderRadius": "6px" } } }. Themeable parts: body, container, h1, h2, h3, paragraph, link, image, button, codeBlock, inlineCode.

property.caption: Variables
property.description: Optional list of merge variables the user can insert into the template, for example first name or order number.

property.caption: Variable name
property.description: Attribute holding the token name, without delimiters. For example firstName.

property.caption: Variable label
property.description: Optional attribute with a friendly label shown in the insert menu. Falls back to the variable name.

property.caption: Sample value
property.description: Optional attribute with an example value. Used to fill in the variables in the Preview view.

property.caption: Prefix
property.description: Characters placed before the variable name.

property.caption: Suffix
property.description: Characters placed after the variable name.

property.caption: Image handling
property.description: How images dropped or pasted into the editor are turned into a URL. Data URL embeds the image in the template and needs no back end, but many email clients will not render it. Microflow hands the upload to your app and is the option to use in production.

property.caption: Upload: image data
property.description: String attribute that receives the base64 encoded file, without the data URL prefix, before the upload action runs.

property.caption: Upload: file name
property.description: Optional string attribute that receives the original file name before the upload action runs.

property.caption: Upload: resulting URL
property.description: String attribute your upload action fills with the public URL of the stored image. The editor waits for this attribute to change and then inserts the image.

property.caption: Upload action
property.description: Runs after the image data has been written to the attributes. Store the file and put its URL in the resulting URL attribute.

property.caption: Upload timeout (s)
property.description: How long to wait for the upload action to fill the resulting URL attribute before giving up.

property.caption: On save
property.description: Runs after the template has been written to the attributes by the Save button, by Ctrl+S, or by an automatic save.

property.caption: On change
property.description: Runs after an edit, once the editor has been idle for the change delay. In automatic save mode it runs after the attributes have been written; a manual save that happens first supersedes it, and On save runs instead.
